name: v6-manova-py
description: Federated one-way MANOVA: tests whether groups differ on several numeric outcomes at once (Wilks, Pillai, Hotelling-Lawley, Roy), exact from per-group sums and cross-products.

functions.name: manova
functions.description: Federated one-way MANOVA (Wilks, Pillai, Hotelling-Lawley, Roy) computed exactly from per-group sums and cross-product matrices

arguments.name: group_column
arguments.description: Column defining the groups (the MANOVA factor).

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Organizations to include in the analysis. Defaults to all organizations in the collaboration.

functions.name: compute_local_summary
functions.description: Per-group counts, sums and cross-product matrices of the outcome columns at one node.

arguments.name: group_column
arguments.description: Column defining the groups (the MANOVA factor).
